notes.zh-CN: 修复侧栏待审批数字气泡挂错标签页的问题。此前只要有待审批请求，气泡就出现在 Bots 标签上，即使请求来自你自己的对话。现在按请求所属会话分流：对话里的请求显示在「对话」，Bot 线程的请求显示在「Bots」，点击气泡仍会打开审批抽屉。
notes.en: Fixes the pending-approval badge landing on the wrong sidebar tab. Any waiting request used to badge Bots, even when it came from one of your own chats. Each tab now counts only the requests listed under it, and clicking the badge still opens the approval drawer.
